conventions.convention: Geometric electrovac uses signature (−,+,+,+), R(X,Y)Z = ∇X∇YZ − ∇Y∇XZ − ∇[X,Y]Z, the independently specified orientation, and equations d𝓕 = d(⋆𝓕) = 0 and Ric = 2Q(𝓕), with zero cosmological constant.
ε₀ = (μ₀c²)⁻¹, α = √(4πG_N/(μ₀c⁴)), 𝓕 = αF, M = G_Nm*/c², Q_e = ε₀c∫⋆F, and Φ_B = ∫F. Geometric electric and magnetic flux parameters divide the respective geometric integrals by 4π.
The physical equation model is adopted rather than derived. Setting j = T^m = 0 without matter fields selects its named singleton zero-matter instance; this batch also sets Λ = 0.

The multicenter family has finitely many distinct removed centers, positive mass lengths, one common electric sign σ, and outward Euclidean sphere orientations. Local sphere closed balls contain no other center; outer spheres strictly enclose all centers.
The RN scaling limit means C∞ local convergence on compact subsets of ℝ × (0,∞) × S². The scaling parameter λ is positive and dimensionless; R = 0 is excluded.

Null-wave coordinates have length units, a and b are smooth inverse-length profiles, h is smooth and dimensionless with h_xx + h_yy = 0, orientation is du∧dv∧dx∧dy, and N = ∂u + (P+1)∂v/2 selects the future direction.
The inherited background assumes AC_ω: every countable family of nonempty sets has a choice function. No full arbitrary-index choice assumption is introduced.

load_bearing.statement: A smooth geometric electrovac datum on a nonempty smooth four-manifold, rescaled by F = α⁻¹𝓕 with α² = 4πG_N/(μ₀c⁴), satisfies dF = 0, ∇_aF^{ab} = 0, and G_ab = κ_E T^EM_ab in the adopted Λ = j = T^m = 0 SI model.

For finitely many distinct centers, positive selected SI masses and one common sign, H = 1 + Σ_A m_A/|x−a_A| gives the stated source-free SI solution on the punctured exterior. Isolated outward spheres have Q_e,A = σ√(4πε₀G_N)m*,A and zero magnetic flux; an outer sphere has the sum of the electric fluxes.
For L > 0 and either specified nonempty open product domain with f(z) = z² or f(z) = 1+z², g = L²(−f dτ² + f⁻¹ dz² + γ_S²) and F = −α⁻¹L dτ∧dz satisfy the adopted source-free SI equations.
For the stated arbitrary smooth a,b and smooth transverse harmonic h, the displayed null-wave metric and F = α⁻¹(a du∧dx + b du∧dy) satisfy the source-free SI Einstein–Maxwell equations on all of ℝ⁴.

For extremal RN parameters M = q_e = L > 0 and q_m = 0 on r > L, pullback by x⁰ = T/λ and r = L+λR converges in C∞ local topology on R > 0 to the displayed constant-radius product metric and geometric two-form, identified with the f(z) = z² product by T = Lτ and R = Lz.

Every specified null-wave datum has 𝓕_ab𝓕^{ab} = S = Ric_abRic^{ab} = R_abcdR^{abcd} = 0, with independent curvature components R_uiuj = −P_ij/2. If a(u₀)²+b(u₀)² > 0, its Riemann tensor is nonzero there.

concerns.concern: F4 and Proof 1.1 apply the identity d(⋆F) = −ι_v vol directly to the rescaled field. The cited lem-emg-maxwell-current-forms Statement first assumes dF = 0 and ∇_aF^{ab} = −μ₀j^b; the latter is not yet established for the source-free current at this point. This is readily closed by explicitly applying the lemma with the auxiliary smooth current j = −v/μ₀ after establishing dF = 0, or by identifying its hypothesis-independent Proof 2.1 calculation. The citation currently suppresses that justification.

The Carroll locator says 'Chapter 7, equations (7.152)–(7.160), for the charged Einstein–Maxwell system and RN conventions'. In the archived complete gr-qc/9712019v1 PDF, (7.152) is Kerr extractable energy, (7.153)–(7.156) concern area/thermodynamics, and Chapter 7 ends at (7.156). RN metric, field and horizon formulas are (7.110)–(7.113), PDF page 209, printed page 202. The local proof does not rely on the erroneous locator.

The Carroll locator says 'Chapter 7, equations (7.157)–(7.161), for dyonic RN conventions and the extremal parameter relation'. Those equation numbers do not occur in Chapter 7 of the cited archived gr-qc/9712019v1 PDF, which ends at (7.156). The RN discussion begins with (7.110)–(7.113), PDF page 209, printed page 202. The coordinate and parameter proof is otherwise supplied locally.

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplying definitions and geometric verifications against the consuming formulas: harmonicity and regular-sphere fluxes, the open single-center RN correspondence, both product branches, positive-radius local scaling convergence, and the full smooth null-wave profile class agree. The consumer preserves domain restrictions and draft proof status.

The SI parameter definition and RN model supply the normalization, mass/charge maps, and source-free equation convention actually used. Substituting Q_e = σ√(4πε₀G_N)m* gives q_e = σM; the RN exterior and scaling-limit uses retain f ≠ 0 and their stated positive-radius domains. No ADM/Komar identification or empirical realization is inferred.
